page: Microsoft Azure NV72ads_A10_v5 is a high-capacity, GPU-accelerated virtual machine within the NVADSA10v5 series, built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 AMD processors delivering 72 vCPUs alongside 880.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.22 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by two discrete NVIDIA A10 GPUs offering a combined total of 48 GB GDDR6 VRAM.

For local disk I/O demands, the instance includes 3092 GB of onboard SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage options for scalable disk throughput. It operates without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard virtual networking configurations for external ingress and egress. The combination of extensive host memory, high core count, and bundled high-capacity local SSDs offers significant density for deployments that require large working sets adjacent to processing hardware.

In terms of qualitative efficiency, the NV72ads_A10_v5 provides a balanced consolidation platform by pairing substantial system memory and compute scale with mid-range enterprise accelerator hardware rather than top-tier training accelerators. This configuration is particularly suited for concurrent virtual workstations, graphics rendering pipelines, video processing, computer-aided engineering, deep learning inference, and memory-intensive analytical workloads that leverage GPU acceleration.
